empirical.vietnamese: mang tính thực nghiệm / dựa trên dữ liệu thực tế
empirical.definition: Based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory or pure logic.
empirical.example: Empirical evidence from three separate studies strongly supports the proposed hypothesis.

substantiate.vietnamese: chứng minh / đưa ra bằng chứng xác thực
substantiate.definition: Provide evidence to support or prove the truth of an assertion or hypothesis.
substantiate.example: The author fails to substantiate the claim that digital transformation directly causes performance gain.

delineate.vietnamese: phác họa / vạch rõ ranh giới
delineate.definition: Describe or portray something precisely or indicate the exact position of a boundary.
delineate.example: Future research should more clearly delineate the boundary conditions under which this effect holds.

paramount.vietnamese: tối quan trọng / có ý nghĩa quyết định
paramount.definition: More important than anything else; supreme in rank or significance.
paramount.example: Maintaining sample representativeness is of paramount importance in survey research.

caveat.vietnamese: điều cảnh báo / điểm lưu ý giới hạn
caveat.definition: A warning or proviso of specific stipulations, conditions, or limitations.
caveat.example: A major caveat of this cross-sectional study is that causal directionality cannot be conclusively established.

paradigm.definition: A typical example or pattern of something; a world view underlying the theories and methodology of a scientific discipline.
paradigm.example: The shift from logical positivism to constructivism represents a fundamental paradigm change in social science.

epistemic.vietnamese: thuộc về nhận thức luận / tri thức luận
epistemic.definition: Relating to knowledge or to the degree of its validation and justification.
epistemic.example: The researchers addressed the epistemic uncertainty inherent in subjective probability estimates.

parsimony.vietnamese: tính cô đọng / nguyên lý tiết kiệm trong mô hình
parsimony.definition: The principle that the simplest acceptable explanation is preferred (Occam's razor).
parsimony.example: In structural equation modeling, model selection criteria such as AIC reward parsimony.

heuristic.vietnamese: nguyên tắc kinh nghiệm / quy tắc phỏng đoán
heuristic.definition: Enabling a person to discover or learn something for themselves; a practical shortcut for problem-solving.
heuristic.example: Hair's threshold of Cronbach's alpha > 0.70 serves as a useful rule-of-thumb heuristic.

juxtapose.vietnamese: đặt cạnh nhau để đối chiếu
juxtapose.definition: Place or deal with close together for contrasting effect.
juxtapose.example: We juxtapose classical test theory against item response theory to highlight their differing assumptions.

commensurate.vietnamese: tương xứng / tương đương về tầm vóc
commensurate.definition: Corresponding in size, extent, amount, or degree; proportionate.
commensurate.example: The statistical power of the test must be commensurate with the expected effect size in the population.

ubiquitous.definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere simultaneously.
ubiquitous.example: Likert scales are ubiquitous in empirical behavioral and organizational research.

robust.vietnamese: vững vàng / bất biến trước các vi phạm giả định
robust.definition: Able to withstand or overcome adverse conditions; statistical methods that perform well even when assumptions are violated.
robust.example: The Satorra-Bentler scaled chi-square provides robust standard errors under non-normal data.

salient.example: The qualitative findings illuminate several salient factors influencing consumer technology adoption.

confound.vietnamese: yếu tố gây nhiễu / làm sai lệch mối quan hệ
confound.definition: A variable that influences both the dependent variable and independent variable, causing a spurious association.
confound.example: Controlling for pre-existing firm size is critical to avoid confounding the estimated treatment effect.

elucidate.vietnamese: làm sáng tỏ / giải thích chi tiết
elucidate.definition: Make something clear; explain in an intelligible and thorough manner.
elucidate.example: The mediation analysis helps elucidate the psychological mechanism linking leadership style to employee performance.

disparity.vietnamese: sự chênh lệch / sự khác biệt lớn
disparity.definition: A great difference or inequality between two or more groups or metrics.
disparity.example: The disparity between self-reported behavior and objective log data illustrates social desirability bias.

consensus.definition: A general agreement among the members of a given group or scientific community.
consensus.example: There is now broad consensus that common method bias must be diagnosed using both procedural and statistical methods.

preliminary.vietnamese: sơ bộ / bước chuẩn bị ban đầu
preliminary.definition: Denoting an action or event preceding or done in preparation for something fuller or more important.
preliminary.example: The preliminary pilot study identified three problematic items that were subsequently reworded.

intrinsic.vietnamese: nội tại / thuộc về bản chất cốt lõi
intrinsic.definition: Belonging naturally; essential; originating from within.
intrinsic.example: Intrinsic motivation demonstrates a stronger and more enduring relationship with creativity than extrinsic rewards.

extrinsic.vietnamese: ngoại lai / từ bên ngoài tác động vào
extrinsic.definition: Not part of the essential nature of someone or something; coming or operating from outside.
extrinsic.example: Extrinsic factors such as compensation did not moderate the hypothesized relationship.

contingent.vietnamese: phụ thuộc vào điều kiện / mang tính ngẫu biến
contingent.definition: Subject to chance; occurring or existing only if certain other circumstances are the case; dependent on.
contingent.example: The effect of market orientation on profitability is contingent upon environmental turbulence.

plausible.vietnamese: hợp lý / có cơ sở chấp nhận được
plausible.definition: Seeming reasonable or probable from a theoretical standpoint.
plausible.example: The authors proposed a plausible theoretical rationale grounded in social exchange theory.

rigor.vietnamese: sự chặt chẽ / độ chuẩn xác khoa học nghiêm ngặt
rigor.definition: The quality of being extremely thorough, exhaustive, or accurate in methodological execution.
rigor.example: Employing triangulation between qualitative interviews and quantitative surveys enhanced methodological rigor.

synthesize.vietnamese: tổng hợp / kết hợp đa nguồn
synthesize.definition: Combine a number of things into a coherent whole.
synthesize.example: The literature review synthesizes findings from over 80 empirical articles across three decades.

facet.definition: One side of something many-sided, especially of a multidimensional construct.
facet.example: Customer satisfaction encompasses multiple distinct facets including service quality, pricing, and convenience.

dichotomy.vietnamese: cặp lưỡng phân / sự phân đôi đối lập
dichotomy.definition: A division or contrast between two things that are or are represented as being opposed or entirely different.
dichotomy.example: The traditional dichotomy between qualitative and quantitative research has been bridged by mixed methods designs.

tenable.vietnamese: có thể đứng vững / có thể bảo vệ được
tenable.definition: Able to be maintained or defended against attack or objection.
tenable.example: The assumption of tau-equivalence is rarely tenable in real-world multidimensional scale development.

corroborate.vietnamese: củng cố / đối soát xác nhận thêm
corroborate.definition: Confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding with independent evidence.
corroborate.example: The survey results corroborate the findings previously derived from exploratory focus groups.

nuance.vietnamese: sắc thái tinh tế / điểm phân biệt nhỏ
nuance.definition: A subtle difference in or shade of meaning, expression, or theoretical mechanism.
nuance.example: Qualitative field notes captured the contextual nuances that standard survey scales overlooked.

diverge.vietnamese: phân kỳ / rẽ sang hướng khác
diverge.definition: Develop in a different direction; depart from a standard path or finding.
diverge.example: Our empirical findings diverge sharply from earlier studies conducted in developed Western markets.

converge.vietnamese: hội tụ / cùng hướng về một điểm
converge.definition: Come together from different directions so as to eventually meet; indicators demonstrating high correlation to reflect the same construct.
converge.example: Multiple measures converged to confirm the presence of high construct validity.

proxy.vietnamese: biến đại diện / biến ủy quyền
proxy.definition: A figure that can be used to represent the value of something in a calculation or model.
proxy.example: R&D expenditure is commonly used in econometric literature as a proxy for firm innovation capability.

manifest.vietnamese: hiển lộ / có thể quan sát trực tiếp
manifest.definition: Clear or obvious to the eye or mind; in SEM, an observed variable directly measured in the survey.
manifest.example: Survey items serve as manifest indicators of the underlying latent psychological construct.

latent.vietnamese: tiềm ẩn / không thể quan sát trực tiếp
latent.definition: Existing but not yet developed or manifest; hidden or concealed; a construct inferred from manifest variables.
latent.example: Job satisfaction is a latent construct that cannot be measured directly with a single physical instrument.

tentative.vietnamese: mang tính thăm dò / chưa dứt khoát
tentative.definition: Not certain or fixed; provisional; done without confidence.
tentative.example: Given the small sample size, the authors offer only tentative conclusions regarding the causal direction.

iterate.vietnamese: lặp lại quy trình để tinh chỉnh
iterate.definition: Perform repeatedly, normally in pursuit of an approach to a desired goal or refined model.
iterate.example: Scale purification is an iterative process of dropping weak items and re-estimating factor models.

overarching.vietnamese: bao quát / bao trùm toàn diện
overarching.example: Resource-based theory serves as the overarching theoretical framework for this dissertation.

pragmatic.vietnamese: mang tính thực dụng / lấy hiệu quả làm tiêu chuẩn
pragmatic.definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.
pragmatic.example: Mixed methods research adopts a pragmatic worldview focused on solving the research problem.

seminal.vietnamese: mang tính chất nền tảng / mở đường
seminal.example: Fornell and Larcker's seminal 1981 paper laid the foundation for evaluating discriminant validity in SEM.

pervasive.vietnamese: lan tỏa khắp nơi / phổ biến rộng khắp
pervasive.definition: Spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people.
pervasive.example: Endogeneity is a pervasive problem in observational empirical studies in strategic management.

aggregate.vietnamese: tập hợp / tổng hợp cấp vĩ mô
aggregate.definition: A whole formed by combining several separate elements.
aggregate.example: Firm performance was measured as an aggregate composite of financial and operational indicators.

anomaly.vietnamese: điểm dị biệt / ngoại lệ bất thường
anomaly.definition: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected in theoretical predictions.
anomaly.example: The negative correlation observed between incentives and effort was an anomaly that prompted further qualitative inquiry.

mitigate.vietnamese: giảm nhẹ / làm dịu bớt / hạn chế tác động tiêu cực
mitigate.definition: Make less severe, serious, or painful; lessen the gravity of an offense or mistake.
mitigate.example: Several procedural remedies were implemented to mitigate common method bias.

operationalize.vietnamese: thao tác hoá / cụ thể hoá khái niệm thành biến đo lường
operationalize.definition: Define a concept in terms of the specific empirical processes or tests used to determine its presence or quantity.
operationalize.example: The authors operationalize organizational resilience using a 12-item validated Likert scale.

attenuate.vietnamese: làm suy giảm / làm yếu đi (mối quan hệ hoặc hiệu ứng)
attenuate.definition: Reduce the force, effect, or value of a relationship or statistical effect.
attenuate.example: Measurement error can attenuate the estimated relationship between constructs.

postulate.vietnamese: định đề / đặt giả thuyết nền tảng
postulate.definition: Suggest or assume the existence, fact, or truth of something as a basis for reasoning, discussion, or belief.
postulate.example: We postulate that psychological safety moderates the effect of leadership on creative performance.

explicate.vietnamese: giải thích tường minh / làm sáng tỏ bản chất khái niệm
explicate.definition: Analyze and develop an idea or principle in detail, explaining its components clearly.
explicate.example: In this section, we explicate the theoretical mechanisms linking dynamic capabilities to competitive advantage.

concomitant.vietnamese: đồng thời xảy ra / đi kèm song song
concomitant.definition: Naturally accompanying or associated with something else, often occurring together.
concomitant.example: The rapid expansion of digital platforms brought a concomitant increase in privacy concerns.

dearth.vietnamese: sự khan hiếm / sự thiếu hụt trầm trọng các nghiên cứu trước
dearth.definition: A scarcity or lack of something, especially empirical research on a specific topic.
dearth.example: Despite the practical relevance of algorithmic aversion, there is a notable dearth of empirical studies on this issue.

proclivity.vietnamese: khuynh hướng / thiên hướng hành vi
proclivity.definition: A tendency to choose or do something regularly; an inclination or predisposition toward a particular behavior.
proclivity.example: Consumers with a high proclivity for status-seeking exhibited stronger brand loyalty toward luxury products.

antithetical.vietnamese: đối lập trực diện / hoàn toàn tương phản
antithetical.definition: Directly opposed or mutually incompatible in essence, principle, or theoretical foundation.
antithetical.example: Coercive governance mechanisms are fundamentally antithetical to psychological safety in collaborative teams.

parsimonious.vietnamese: tối giản nhưng hiệu quả (tiết kiệm tham số / hàm súc)
parsimonious.definition: Frugal or economical, especially of a scientific model that explains the maximum variance with the fewest predictors (Occam's razor).
parsimonious.example: A parsimonious model with three core constructs demonstrated superior out-of-sample predictive performance.

efficacious.vietnamese: có hiệu lực thực tế / đạt được kết quả mong đợi
efficacious.definition: Successful in producing a desired or intended result; effective in practice.
efficacious.example: Nudge interventions proved particularly efficacious in promoting sustainable consumption behaviors.

spurious.vietnamese: giả mạo / tương quan ảo (do có biến thứ ba gây nhiễu)
spurious.definition: Not being what it purports to be; false, illegitimate, or showing a statistical correlation caused by an unobserved confounder.
spurious.example: After controlling for household income, the apparent relationship between education and asset ownership was rendered spurious.

endogenous.vietnamese: nội sinh (được xác định bên trong hệ thống hoặc tương quan với sai số)
endogenous.definition: Having an internal cause or origin; in econometrics, correlated with the error term in a regression model.
endogenous.example: Because firm performance is potentially endogenous, we employ a two-stage least squares instrumental variable approach.

exogenous.vietnamese: ngoại sinh (độc lập với sai số / do cú sốc bên ngoài)
exogenous.definition: Relating to or developing from external factors; in econometrics, uncorrelated with the error term of the equation.
exogenous.example: The unexpected regulatory reform served as a quasi-natural experiment providing exogenous variation in corporate disclosure.

ameliorate.vietnamese: cải thiện / làm giảm thiểu tác động tiêu cực
ameliorate.definition: Make something bad, unsatisfactory, or deficient better or more tolerable.
ameliorate.example: Participative leadership practices help ameliorate the detrimental effects of job burnout on turnover intentions.

equifinality.vietnamese: tính đồng kết / nhiều con đường khác nhau cùng dẫn đến một kết quả
equifinality.definition: The principle that in open systems a given final state can be reached by many potential means and different pathways (core concept in fsQCA).
equifinality.example: Fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) revealed equifinality, showing that three distinct configurations led to high firm innovation.

nomological.vietnamese: thuộc mạng lưới lý thuyết quy luật / giá trị mạng lưới lý thuyết
nomological.definition: Relating to the principles of science and the laws of nature; establishing lawful relationships among theoretical constructs (nomological network).
nomological.example: We established nomological validity by demonstrating that the new construct correlated as predicted with established antecedent and outcome variables.

tautological.vietnamese: trùng ngôn vô nghĩa / định nghĩa vòng quanh luẩn quẩn
tautological.definition: Needless repetition of an idea, statement, or word where a proposition explains nothing because the conclusion is identical to the premise.
tautological.example: Reviewers criticized the hypothesis as tautological because customer satisfaction was defined using virtually the same items as product quality.

isomorphism.vietnamese: tính đồng cấu / xu hướng các tổ chức ngày càng trở nên giống nhau
isomorphism.definition: A similarity of the processes or structure of one organization to those of another, be it the result of imitation (mimetic), coercion, or norms (DiMaggio & Powell, 1983).
isomorphism.example: Institutional theory suggests that coercive isomorphism drives firms in the energy sector to adopt standardized sustainability reporting.

idiosyncratic.vietnamese: đặc thù cá biệt / riêng biệt không thể khái quát
idiosyncratic.definition: Relating to individual, unique, or peculiar characteristics that do not conform to general rules or universal patterns.
idiosyncratic.example: Case study research allows scholars to investigate idiosyncratic context-specific factors that large-scale surveys overlook.

orthogonal.vietnamese: trực giao / hoàn toàn độc lập tuyến tính (tương quan bằng 0)
orthogonal.definition: Statistically independent or uncorrelated; in factor analysis, dimensions that are at right angles to one another (Varimax rotation).
orthogonal.example: The principal component analysis extracted three orthogonal dimensions explaining 68% of the total variance.

coalesce.vietnamese: hợp nhất / kết tụ thành một khối thống nhất
coalesce.definition: Come together to form one mass, whole, or unified conceptual perspective.
coalesce.example: Qualitative interview findings coalesced into five overarching themes reflecting participants' lived experiences.

disseminate.vietnamese: phổ biến rộng rãi kết quả nghiên cứu
disseminate.definition: Spread something, especially scientific knowledge, findings, or data widely to stakeholders and academic communities.
disseminate.example: The grant requires researchers to disseminate their empirical findings through both open-access journals and policy briefs.

equivocal.vietnamese: mơ hồ / có nhiều cách hiểu mâu thuẫn nhau
equivocal.definition: Open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous or inconclusive in empirical evidence.
equivocal.example: Prior empirical studies yielded equivocal findings regarding the performance implications of corporate social responsibility.

subsume.vietnamese: bao hàm / gộp vào một phạm trù khái niệm rộng hơn
subsume.definition: Include or absorb something into a more comprehensive, higher-order category or concept.
subsume.example: Under the unified framework, situational and emotional factors are subsumed under the broader construct of psychological climate.

interpolate.vietnamese: nội suy / ước lượng giá trị nằm giữa các mốc đã biết
interpolate.definition: Estimate or insert values between two known values in a sequence or series of empirical observations.
interpolate.example: Missing quarterly data points were interpolated using a cubic spline regression algorithm.

extrapolate.vietnamese: ngoại suy / suy rộng kết quả ra ngoài phạm vi quan sát
extrapolate.definition: Extend the application of a method or conclusion, especially beyond the range of known observations into a larger context.
extrapolate.example: Caution must be exercised when extrapolating findings from laboratory student samples to corporate executive populations.

heterogeneity.vietnamese: tính không đồng nhất / sự đa dạng dị biệt của các quan sát
heterogeneity.definition: The quality or state of being diverse in character or content; variation in study outcomes or parameters across sub-populations.
heterogeneity.example: The random-effects meta-analysis accounted for substantial statistical heterogeneity (I² = 74%) across included studies.

homogeneity.vietnamese: tính đồng nhất / sự thuần nhất của phương sai hoặc mẫu nghiên cứu
homogeneity.definition: The state of being all the same or all of the same kind; equal variance across groups (homoskedasticity).
homogeneity.example: Levene's test confirmed the homogeneity of variance assumption (p > .05) across all four experimental conditions.

interlocutor.vietnamese: người đối thoại / người tham gia phỏng vấn
interlocutor.definition: A person who takes part in a dialogue or conversation; a key informant in qualitative ethnographic research.
interlocutor.example: Researchers maintained regular dialogue with key institutional interlocutors to capture shifting governance norms.

paradoxical.vietnamese: nghịch lý nhưng có thật / dường như mâu thuẫn
paradoxical.definition: Seemingly absurd or self-contradictory, yet expressing a possible truth or empirical reality.
paradoxical.example: We observed a paradoxical effect where higher perceived risk increased consumer engagement with automated advisory systems.

juxtaposition.vietnamese: sự đặt cạnh nhau để so sánh đối chiếu
juxtaposition.definition: The fact of two things being seen or placed close together with contrasting effect.
juxtaposition.example: The juxtaposition of qualitative narratives and econometric estimates provided a richer understanding of policy implementation.

manifestation.vietnamese: biểu hiện cụ thể ra bên ngoài của biến tiềm ẩn
manifestation.definition: An event, action, or object that clearly shows or embodies something, especially an abstract theoretical construct.
manifestation.example: Employee absenteeism and cynical comments were identified as observable manifestations of organizational cynicism.

bifurcate.vietnamese: phân nhánh làm đôi / rẽ làm hai hướng
bifurcate.definition: Divide into two distinct branches, directions, or theoretical streams.
bifurcate.example: The literature on strategic agility bifurcates into resource-based and behavioral-adaptation perspectives.

abstract.vietnamese: bản tóm tắt bài báo / trừu tượng phi cụ thể
abstract.definition: A summary of the contents of a book, article, or formal speech; existing in thought or as an idea.
abstract.example: The abstract succinctly outlines the research objectives, methodology, and primary empirical findings.

acknowledge.vietnamese: thừa nhận / tri ân đóng góp học thuật
acknowledge.definition: Accept or admit the existence or truth of; express gratitude for funding or assistance.
acknowledge.example: The authors acknowledge the financial support provided by the National Science Foundation.

acquire.vietnamese: thu nhận / tiếp thu tri thức hoặc kỹ năng
acquire.definition: Buy or obtain for oneself; learn or develop an asset, trait, or knowledge.
acquire.example: Organizations acquire dynamic capabilities through iterative experiential learning cycles.

adapt.vietnamese: thích ứng / điều chỉnh thang đo phù hợp bối cảnh
adapt.definition: Make suitable for a new use or purpose; modify a validated scale for a new cultural context.
adapt.example: We adapted the measurement items from Hair et al. to fit the Vietnamese banking context.

adequate.vietnamese: thỏa đáng / đạt chuẩn chất lượng tối thiểu
adequate.definition: Satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity to support valid statistical inferences.
adequate.example: The Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin value of 0.84 indicates adequate sampling adequacy for factor analysis.

adjacent.vietnamese: kế cận / liền kề trong mạng lưới phân tích
adjacent.definition: Next to or adjoining something else; neighboring concepts in a theoretical network.
adjacent.example: We examine adjacent conceptual domains to identify potential boundary-spanning variables.

advocate.vietnamese: chủ trương / người ủng hộ trường phái lý thuyết
advocate.definition: Publicly recommend or support a particular methodology, paradigm, or policy.
advocate.example: Scholars advocate using bootstrapping intervals rather than normal-theory Sobel tests.

allocate.vietnamese: phân bổ ngẫu nhiên người tham gia vào các nhóm
allocate.definition: Distribute resources or assign experimental participants to specific treatment conditions.
allocate.example: Participants were randomly allocated to either the treatment group or the placebo control condition.

alter.vietnamese: thay đổi / điều chỉnh tham số nghiên cứu
alter.definition: Change in character or composition, typically in a comparatively small but significant way.
alter.example: Introducing the mediator altered the direct relationship between leadership and firm performance.

ambiguous.vietnamese: mơ hồ / đa nghĩa gây nhiễu đo lường
ambiguous.definition: Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
ambiguous.example: Ambiguous survey items were eliminated during the pilot pre-testing phase to avoid measurement error.

analogy.vietnamese: phép loại suy / so sánh tương đồng logic
analogy.definition: A comparison between one thing and another, typically for the purpose of explanation or clarification.
analogy.example: The authors draw an analogy between biological evolution and organizational adaptation.

anticipate.vietnamese: tiên liệu / dự đoán trước kết quả
anticipate.definition: Regard as probable; expect or predict theoretically prior to empirical testing.
anticipate.example: We anticipate that perceived usefulness will moderate the adoption of autonomous technologies.

apparent.vietnamese: rõ ràng hiển hiện / có vẻ như thực tế
apparent.definition: Clearly visible or understood; seeming real or true, but not necessarily so.
apparent.example: The apparent correlation disappeared entirely once unobserved firm fixed effects were controlled.

append.vietnamese: đính kèm / bổ sung vào phần phụ lục
append.definition: Add something as an attachment or supplement to a formal academic report.
append.example: The complete survey questionnaire and correlation matrices are appended in the online supplementary file.

arbitrary.vietnamese: tùy tiện / không có căn cứ phương pháp luận
arbitrary.definition: Based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or scientific system.
arbitrary.example: Choosing a sample size without statistical power analysis represents an arbitrary research decision.

articulate.vietnamese: diễn đạt mạch lạc / làm rõ lập luận khoa học
articulate.definition: Express an idea or feeling fluently and coherently in academic writing.
articulate.example: The author articulates a compelling theoretical rationale for the hypothesized moderation effect.

aspect.vietnamese: khía cạnh / chiều kích của hiện tượng
aspect.definition: A particular part or feature of something being investigated.
aspect.example: Emotional exhaustion represents the core psychological aspect of the burnout syndrome.

assemble.vietnamese: tập hợp / thu thập bộ dữ liệu đa nguồn
assemble.definition: Gather together in one place; collect and merge empirical data from multiple archives.
assemble.example: We assemble a unique panel dataset spanning 500 listed firms over a ten-year observation window.

assert.vietnamese: khẳng định / xác quyết luận điểm khoa học
assert.definition: State a fact or belief confidently and forcefully on theoretical grounds.
assert.example: Institutional theorists assert that regulatory compliance is critical for organizational legitimacy.

assign.vietnamese: gán / phân công ngẫu nhiên đối tượng
assign.definition: Designate someone to a specific experimental condition or allocate a code to text.
assign.example: Subjects were randomly assigned to high-threat and low-threat experimental scenarios.

attain.vietnamese: đạt được / chạm tới ngưỡng chuẩn thống kê
attain.definition: Succeed in achieving a desired statistical threshold, benchmark, or theoretical saturation.
attain.example: Qualitative data collection ceased once the emergent coding categories attained theoretical saturation.

attribute.vietnamese: thuộc tính đo lường / quy kết nguyên nhân
attribute.definition: A quality or feature regarded as a characteristic or inherent part of someone or something.
attribute.example: Product quality and brand prestige are key attributes driving consumer purchase intention.

authentic.vietnamese: chân thực / đáng tin cậy trong nghiên cứu định tính
authentic.definition: Of undisputed origin and not a copy; genuine representation of participants' perspectives.
authentic.example: Thick verbatim quotations provide authentic empirical evidence supporting the inductive themes.

clarify.vietnamese: làm rõ / sáng tỏ mối quan hệ mập mờ
clarify.definition: Make a statement or situation less confused and more clearly comprehensible.
clarify.example: This longitudinal study clarifies the causal direction between job satisfaction and employee voice.

coherent.vietnamese: chặt chẽ mạch lạc / có tính nhất quán logic
coherent.definition: Logical and consistent in theoretical argumentation and methodological structure.
coherent.example: The manuscript presents a coherent conceptual framework integrating resource-based and institutional perspectives.

coincide.vietnamese: trùng hợp ngẫu nhiên về mặt thời gian
coincide.definition: Occur at or during the same time without necessarily implying a causal link.
coincide.example: The policy change coincided with a global economic downturn, confounding the treatment effect.

complementary.vietnamese: bổ sung tương hỗ / phối hợp làm giàu tri thức
complementary.definition: Combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize the qualities of each other.
complementary.example: Qualitative interviews provided complementary insights explaining the quantitative survey anomalies.

comprehensive.vietnamese: toàn diện / bao quát đầy đủ mọi khía cạnh
comprehensive.definition: Complete; including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.
comprehensive.example: The authors conduct a comprehensive systematic review adhering strictly to PRISMA 2020 guidelines.

comprise.vietnamese: bao gồm / cấu thành từ các phần tử
comprise.definition: Consist of; be made up of specific dimensions or operational indicators.
comprise.example: The final validated scale comprises four reflective dimensions totaling sixteen measurement items.

compute.vietnamese: tính toán chỉ số thống kê trên máy tính
compute.definition: Calculate a figure or amount using statistical software and mathematical algorithms.
compute.example: We compute heteroskedasticity-consistent standard errors using White's covariance matrix estimator.

conceive.vietnamese: hình thành ý tưởng lý thuyết / quan niệm hóa
conceive.definition: Form or devise a plan or idea in the mind; formulate a theoretical construct.
conceive.example: Mindfulness is conceived as a multidimensional construct encompassing awareness and acceptance.

conclude.vietnamese: kết luận / suy luận từ chứng cứ thực nghiệm
conclude.definition: Arrive at a judgment or opinion by reasoning on the basis of empirical findings.
conclude.example: Based on the non-significant interaction term, we conclude that gender does not moderate the effect.

concurrent.vietnamese: đồng thời / giá trị đồng thời trong đo lường
concurrent.definition: Existing, happening, or done at the same time; assessing validity against an existing standard.
concurrent.example: Concurrent validity was confirmed by correlating the new test scores with established IQ metrics.

conduct.vietnamese: tiến hành / thực thi quy trình nghiên cứu
conduct.definition: Organize and carry out an empirical investigation or statistical test.
conduct.example: We conducted twenty-five in-depth semi-structured interviews with senior executives.

conform.vietnamese: tuân thủ / phù hợp với các chuẩn mực phương pháp
conform.definition: Comply with rules, standards, or empirical model fit criteria.
conform.example: The measurement model conformed to recommended structural equation modeling fit benchmarks.

consequent.vietnamese: hệ quả tất yếu / phát sinh sau can thiệp
consequent.definition: Following as a result or effect of an experimental manipulation or policy change.
consequent.example: The salary increase and consequent boost in morale led to higher operational productivity.

constitute.vietnamese: cấu thành / đại diện cho bản chất hiện tượng
constitute.definition: Be a part of a whole; serve as the fundamental components of a construct.
constitute.example: Four reflective indicators constitute the operational measurement of organizational agility.

constrain.vietnamese: áp đặt ràng buộc đẳng thức trong mô hình SEM
constrain.definition: Severely restrict or impose mathematical equality constraints on model parameters.
constrain.example: To test metric invariance, factor loadings were constrained to be equal across both cultural groups.

consult.vietnamese: tham vấn / tra cứu tài liệu chuyên khảo
consult.definition: Seek information or advice from an expert panel or peer-reviewed literature.
consult.example: A panel of five senior methodologists was consulted to verify the content validity of the survey.

consume.vietnamese: tiêu thụ / tiếp nhận thông tin học thuật
consume.definition: Use up resources or process and absorb empirical information.
consume.example: Scholars increasingly consume open-access preprints to track cutting-edge discoveries.

contemporary.vietnamese: đương đại / nghiên cứu bối cảnh hiện nay
contemporary.definition: Belonging to or occurring in the present; relevant to current academic debates.
contemporary.example: This research addresses contemporary challenges in generative AI governance within enterprise settings.

context.vietnamese: bối cảnh / môi trường thực địa nghiên cứu
context.definition: The circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea.
context.example: Qualitative research emphasizes how institutional context shapes individual entrepreneurial cognition.

contradict.vietnamese: mâu thuẫn trái ngược / bác bỏ giả thuyết
contradict.definition: Deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite; yield conflicting empirical evidence.
contradict.example: Our empirical findings contradict the dominant agency-theory assumption regarding executive pay.

contrary.vietnamese: trái lại / đi ngược với dự đoán ban đầu
contrary.definition: Opposite in nature, direction, or meaning to previous empirical literature.
contrary.example: Contrary to expectations, psychological distance significantly reduced unethical decision-making.

contrast.vietnamese: đối chiếu / tương phản giữa hai trường phái
contrast.definition: The state of being strikingly different from something else in juxtaposition.
contrast.example: In contrast to quantitative surveys, ethnographic observations uncover tacit institutional norms.

contribute.vietnamese: đóng góp học thuật / gia tăng tri thức mới
contribute.definition: Give something in order to help achieve or provide incremental theoretical value.
contribute.example: This paper contributes to the dynamic capabilities literature by uncovering micro-foundational routines.

controversy.vietnamese: cuộc tranh cãi học thuật gay gắt kéo dài
controversy.definition: Prolonged public disagreement or heated academic debate between competing paradigms.
controversy.example: The debate over CB-SEM versus PLS-SEM has generated substantial controversy in top journals.

convene.vietnamese: triệu tập / tổ chức hội thảo chuyên gia
convene.definition: Come or bring together for a formal meeting or expert focus group.
convene.example: An expert consensus panel was convened to standardize measurement indicators for digital literacy.

converse.vietnamese: mệnh đề đảo ngược / tương tác đối lập
converse.definition: Having a characteristic or condition that is the opposite of something that has been stated.
converse.example: While stress reduces cognitive flexibility, the converse is true for positive affect.

convert.vietnamese: chuyển đổi thang đo / chuẩn hóa dữ liệu
convert.definition: Change the form, character, or function of raw data into standard standardized scores.
convert.example: Raw test scores were converted into standard z-scores to allow cross-instrument comparisons.

convince.vietnamese: thuyết phục phản biện viên / minh chứng vững
convince.definition: Cause someone to believe firmly in the truth of something through rigorous evidence.
convince.example: Robustness checks are crucial to convince reviewers that endogeneity does not drive the findings.

core.vietnamese: hạt nhân cốt lõi / trung tâm của lý thuyết
core.definition: The central or most important part of something; fundamental conceptual category.
core.example: Emotional intelligence represents the core construct within the proposed nomological network.

criteria.vietnamese: các tiêu chuẩn thẩm định học thuật
criteria.definition: Principles or standards by which something may be judged or decided.
criteria.example: Hu and Bentler's cutoff criteria (CFI > 0.95, SRMR < 0.08) were used to evaluate model fit.

crucial.vietnamese: mang tính sống còn / quyết định kết quả
crucial.definition: Decisive or critical, especially in the success or failure of an empirical test.
crucial.example: Controlling for baseline cognitive abilities was crucial for establishing causal validity.
